Author bio: prompt engineer @browsercompany | I make apps. My code runs on 100mil+ phones | former iOSdev @Twitter | indie dev @mindGoblinStdio Download Hivemind⬇️
Text: T3 code is so intriguing. 

Feels like VScode for agents. 
Open source and highly configurable. 

Everyone having agents changes the game of what a dev tool looks like. You won’t download vscode and add extensions, your gonna vibecode your own IDE with a template base. 

If you aren’t building your own dev tools, as a dev, you are giving up control of your creativity. Now it’s basically free to copy paste the best dev tools and adjust them to your preferences & workflow. Why would you use stock codex and Claude code when you can create your own?

Current status; Claude fable & GPT 5.6 subagents are porting T3 into swift so I can merge the best ideas from T3 with my Hivemind app. It’s been running for 30ish hours now. I’m finally dusting this project off because it’s time for a new era of vibe coding.
